mentions.name: Laboratory.love
mentions.description: This project tests consumer products for plastic chemicals and publishes the results to make supply chains transparent. It lets people kick off crowdfunding pages to have regularly consumed products tested, and shows what has been tested so far on its results page.
mentions.problem: Supply chains are opaque with regard to plastic chemicals in consumer products.
mentions.audience: Consumers who eat the same products regularly and want to know about plastic chemicals in them
mentions.source_excerpt: Laboratory.love, still a one-person side project, and the goal is still to make supply chains transparent with regard to plastic chemicals.

evidence.value: Laboratory.love, still a one-person side project, and the goal is still to make supply chains transparent with regard to plastic chemicals.
